reviewed.name: EYE MK.2 professional hand-held compass
reviewed.rationale: The compass has genuine field utility, but pinned SPT 4.1.3 Jaeger already provides it as an unlimited direct offer. Relationship standing would therefore duplicate renewable availability instead of creating a distinct Admiral privilege.

reviewed.name: Vortex Ranger 1500 rangefinder
reviewed.rationale: The handheld rangefinder fits Admiral's reconnaissance theme, but pinned SPT 4.1.3 Jaeger already exposes it with unlimited direct stock. A Relationship copy would be thematic duplication, not meaningful progression.

reviewed.name: Paracord
reviewed.rationale: Paracord is one of the few reviewed items with real recurring field relevance because it supports cliff-style extracts, but it is not consumed by that use and pinned Jaeger also consumes twelve units in a high-value barter. Renewable standing stock would therefore provide little durable relationship benefit after the first owned copy while weakening existing barter scarcity. It is rejected rather than used as LL2/LL3 quota filler.

conclusion.finding: The strongest obvious navigation/observation special-slot candidates are already unlimited vanilla offers, while Paracord fails the independent recurring-supply test despite having legitimate field utility. Empty Relationship tiers remain preferable to duplicate or scarcity-bypassing stock.
